items.text: Internet prices have increased by 30%, and bread has become rationed. The fourth gasoline price was announced as 110,000 tomans, and there will be a gas shortage in winter. Prices in various sectors such as chicken, bakeries, car repairs, and medicine have risen sharply.

A group of justice-seeking families gathered at the graves of the immortalized in Nishapur and commemorated them. Haider Karimi's mother was also present beside the tomb of Bahar Shahmehri; two immortalized from the December 1404 protests who were buried a few hours apart in Shadmehrak Cemetery in Razavi Khorasan Province.

Jonathan Schaech, a Middle East analyst, said the upcoming meeting between Trump and Xi Jinping provides an opportunity for US-China consultations about the Islamic Republic due to Tehran's dependence on China's oil market and Beijing's concern about instability in the Strait of Hormuz. Schaech also said Israel's role in the ongoing confrontation with the Islamic Republic is important, and Israel's security against missile attacks and potential nuclear threats will remain a priority.

The Public Relations of the Islamic Republic Army announced that three oil tankers in the eastern Strait of Hormuz caught fire and stopped due to "collision with naval mines." The army stated that these tankers were navigating in the restricted area of the eastern Strait of Hormuz since Wednesday morning by turning off navigation systems and ignoring naval warnings. No information has been released yet about the identity of the tankers, the crew status, or the extent of the damage.

Jamshid Barzegar said the International Atomic Energy Agency's inability to verify the Islamic Republic's nuclear activities and the ambiguity about the fate of enriched uranium stocks have reduced the likelihood of a diplomatic resolution to the war. He added that Tehran's opposition to the return of agency inspectors and the transfer of uranium stocks abroad has also thwarted Qatar's mediation efforts to build trust between Tehran and Washington. Barzegar also said the Islamic Republic has expanded its missile and cyber threats and seeks to increase pressure on the US.
A citizen sent a video to Iran International showing the polluted air in Tehran and said that the Islamic Republic had claimed the air had become pleasant, but now the air is not breathable.

Reza Talebi, a journalist, said Iran and Taiwan are points of disagreement among Donald Trump, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin at the upcoming meeting on the sidelines of the APEC summit. He added that if Trump links these issues to talks about the Ukraine war, it might create grounds for compromise. Talebi also said China has previously changed its stance on the Islamic Republic and might do so again.

The deadline for FIFA presidential candidates ended on 18 November 2026. The election will be held on 18 March 2027 at the 77th FIFA Congress in Rabat. Gianni Infantino, Philippe Diallo, Kozo Tashima, and Ramon Vega are the candidates for the FIFA presidency election.

Morad Vaisi, senior analyst at Iran International, said the fate of Iran is ultimately determined by the Iranian people who have been fighting for nearly 48 years to change the government. He added that Iran has become an important issue in the power equations of major world powers and that Iran is on the table without the presence of the Iranian people. He asked if it is possible to decide the fate of Iran without the presence of Iranians.
A resident of Ilam province sent a video to Iran International showing that on 26 Aban the slogan "Abdanan is not alone" was written on a street wall.

Morad Vaisi, senior analyst at Iran International, said Rafael Grossi, Director General of the International Atomic Energy Agency, states that the Islamic Republic has neither provided information about its nuclear facilities nor allowed inspectors access for 18 months. According to him, the agency is unaware of the status of other facilities except the Bushehr power plant and cannot fulfill its monitoring and reporting obligations.

Morad Vaisi, senior analyst at Iran International, said a potential attack by the US and Israel may weaken the Islamic Republic, but the final overthrow will be carried out by the Iranian people. He added that the people, by returning to the streets of Abdanan, showed that the bloody repression and executions of recent months have not stopped their protests. These protests inspire and encourage other Iranians.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic issued a statement calling on regional governments to prevent the continued use of their territories by the US for planning and conducting operations against Iran, warning that this situation authorizes the Iranian government to take military action against regional countries. The statement added that Iran has so far acted with maximum restraint and has only targeted US military bases and assets in these countries.
A video shows that one of the protesters on Wednesday, 27 Aban in Nakhlestan Park, Saravan, Sistan and Baluchestan province, writes the slogan "Long live the Shah."
In a program with Kambiz Hosseini, accounts about the death of Sogand Sayadi and the father's violence and the school's responsibility were presented.

The Israeli army announced that Brad Cooper, commander of CENTCOM, met with the Chief of Staff of the Israeli army and the head of Mossad on Wednesday during a visit to Israel. This meeting took place amid rising tensions between the US and Iran. Cooper and Zamir also assessed the regional situation with senior military commanders.

According to Bloomberg on Wednesday, 27 Aban, the US aircraft carrier "George Washington," which was stationed in the framework of the naval blockade of Iran in the Persian Gulf, has left the area. It is likely that this carrier will return to its home port in Yokosuka, Japan. The aircraft carrier group "Theodore Roosevelt" remains in the region and is considered a factor in increasing US military options against Iran.

The office of Prince Reza Pahlavi warned about the risk of execution for Omid Janami, a 28-year-old athlete arrested following the December uprising in Zarrinshahr, Isfahan. The office wrote that Omid Janami was held in solitary confinement for 70 days under various tortures including electric shocks and three mock executions, resulting in symptoms of a stroke. He was sentenced to death on charges of disabling city surveillance cameras to prevent citizen arrests, without any evidence.
A video received by Iran International shows a group of schoolgirls in a school in Shahriar singing the song "Young Iran" together on Wednesday, 27 Aban.

Amir Hatami, the Commander-in-Chief of the Islamic Republic Army, said the armed forces are prepared to confront any possible attack based on instructions from Mojtaba Khamenei. He added that if the enemy repeats an attack, the Islamic Republic's response will be "more crushing, severe, and without geographical limitation" and will also include the supporters of the opposing side.

The US Secretary of Homeland Security and the Director of National Intelligence warned about threats from the Islamic Republic against the United States. The US Secretary of Homeland Security said that cyberattacks by the Islamic Republic against government institutions and organizations in the US have started since February. Amir Giti from Iran International said that the US capability for retaliatory cyberattacks against the Islamic Republic's infrastructure is much broader.
A citizen sent a video to Iran International on Wednesday, 27 Aban, showing a long line of cars in Mahshahr and saying that fuel station attendants do not have cards.

The fifth session of the trial of Mehran Mohaqqeqi, accused of driving a car towards Iranian protesters in Toronto, Canada, ended again without setting a trial date. The defense lawyer requested more time to examine the defendant's recently returned mobile phone. The judge postponed the case to December 16.

Shahram Khaledi said the summit of the leaders of the US, Russia, and China is more an opportunity to secure the interests of these three powers on issues like Taiwan, Ukraine, and the Iran dossier than a sign of a new world order. He added that Moscow and Beijing seek to reduce the damages caused by the war and gain concessions from the Trump administration. Khaledi also said that China and Russia try to use the Iran dossier as leverage in negotiations with the US and that there is a possibility of an increased mediating role for them, but their ability to bring Tehran and Washington closer to an agreement is limited.

Sogand Sayadi, a 16-year-old girl from Kermanshah, died. She had warned before leaving school that returning home with her father was dangerous for her. The circumstances of her death are still unclear.

Yahya Rasoul, spokesperson for the Iraqi Ministry of Defense, said the Iraqi army is awaiting orders to take control of the Jurf al-Sakhar area south of Baghdad. It was reported that Esmail Qaani, commander of the Quds Force of the IRGC, met with Ali Al-Zaidi, the Prime Minister of Iraq, to help reduce tensions. Kata'ib Hezbollah has earned hundreds of millions of dollars through an oil smuggling network.

Mauricio Pochettino is the new manager of Manchester United, which is in the relegation zone of the English Premier League after 10 matches with 8 points. Statistics from the past 31 seasons show that 56% of teams in the bottom three after 10 games have been relegated. This situation is similar to Manchester United's poor start in 1986 when Alex Ferguson took over the team.

The Israeli army released a video showing Brad Cooper, commander of the US Central Command, meeting with Eyal Zamir, Chief of Staff of the Israeli army, and Roman Gafman, head of Mossad, in Tel Aviv. According to the Israeli army, Zamir and Cooper discussed regional developments, shared security challenges, and the importance of deepening strategic and operational cooperation between the two armies.

Trump warned in an interview with Fox News that if the Islamic Republic carries out a bombing attack in Washington, it will destroy the Iranian regime. He said the threat is certain and added that Tehran is pursuing chemical and biological weapons. Trump also said the conflict with the Islamic Republic began 51 years ago.

Trump called the agreement with the Islamic Republic a waste of time in an interview with Fox News and said the US realized it could not trust the Islamic Republic. He considered the blockade the most effective action the US has taken against the Islamic Republic and emphasized that he will soon end dealings with Iran in any form. Trump demanded a lasting agreement that remains valid even with a change of president.

Donald Trump said on the eve of a trilateral meeting with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin that he will not seek their help to end the war with the Iranian government. He emphasized that the US has full control of the Strait of Hormuz and has defeated Iran's naval, air, and air defense forces. The final agenda of the meeting is still unclear, and the chances of a major agreement are considered low.

Putin said at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meeting that Russia helps secure the region's energy and that its partners can always rely on Moscow in this regard. He emphasized that Russia is an integral part of the Asia-Pacific region and urged countries in the region to use Russia's logistical infrastructure for transportation and goods movement.

Trump said that superintelligence is almost entirely good, but it also has some negative aspects. He also emphasized the importance of the US role in Asia and Oceania, stating that the United States has been a power in the Pacific region for hundreds of years and continues to work to strengthen growth, stability, national sovereignty, welfare, and peace throughout the region.

The release of the sixth version of the popular game "GTA" has become an event beyond the world of video games; some companies have given leave to their employees and social networks are full of jokes and reactions to this event.

The Third Committee of the United Nations General Assembly approved a draft resolution condemning the suppression of the protests in Dey 1404 in Iran with 76 votes in favor, 27 against, and 64 abstentions. This resolution was initiated by Canada.

Mohammad Qaedi, an international relations instructor, said Hezbollah uses diverse financial sources, cash, and cryptocurrencies for funding, in addition to gold transfer networks from Africa and Turkey. He stated that the US is trying to limit these routes, but the extensive financial network of Hezbollah in Latin America, Africa, and other regions has made identifying and blocking all financial sources of the group difficult.

Donald Trump and Xi Jinping will meet for the third time this year on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, China. Trump is also scheduled to participate in a trilateral meeting with the presidents of China and Russia. Samira Gharaei, a reporter for Iran International, reports.

Donald Trump, the President of the United States, referred to the failed Islamabad agreement, emphasized distrust towards the Islamic Republic, and considered the blockade of Iran as Washington's most effective measure. At the same time, Islamic Republic officials threatened regional countries with military action and announced targeting oil pipelines and tankers if Iran's oil exports were stopped.

Trump and Putin met on Thursday on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China. Trump told Putin that he thinks good things will happen as a result of this meeting. He added that they have had good relations for many years and this meeting could be the start of good things.

China, Russia, and the Islamic Republic of Iran issued a joint statement at the IAEA Board of Governors emphasizing that military attacks on Iran and its nuclear facilities and the ongoing threat of repeating these attacks have made the normal implementation of the Agency's safeguards practically impossible. The three countries stated that the full resumption of the Agency's verification activities in Iran is conditional on the end of all conflicts, removal of military threats, and provision of credible guarantees to prevent repeated attacks. They also stressed that dialogue and diplomatic interaction based on mutual respect is the only practical solution to advance cooperation between Iran and the Agency.

Sohrab Bakhtiyari-Zadeh, the head coach of Esteghlal, submitted his written resignation to the CEO of Esteghlal after several days of disagreement with club managers over the training ground conditions and team facilities. He was dissatisfied with the lack of a suitable grass field and the failure to provide necessary facilities for players, and after missing Wednesday's training, he officially announced his resignation. This resignation was announced while Esteghlal is scheduled to host Al Ain UAE on the 2nd of Azar in the fifth week of the Asian Elite League.
A video received by Iran International shows slogans of "Long live the Shah" and "Pahlavi is coming back" written on walls in Kian Shahr, Tehran.

Abel Núñez, an 18-year-old Argentine footballer, suffered a skull fracture and internal bleeding after a severe ball impact to his head during a youth football match and died despite surgery. The incident occurred during a match between the youth teams of FC Aziza and Deportivo Muñiz. The match was stopped after the incident and Núñez was taken to the hospital.

Ali Shirazi, a member of Iran International's editorial team, said the Islamic Republic is trying to deter regional rulers from cooperating with the US by increasing threats against regional countries and raising the possibility of expanding the war's geography. He also said Russia and China, in a joint statement on Iran's nuclear file, want to assure Tehran that it still has their support.

Hossein Alizadeh, an international affairs analyst, said Donald Trump's statements about ending the Islamic Republic and reaching a stable agreement remain ambiguous; however, the heavy economic pressure and restrictions imposed on Tehran indicate that Trump seeks to resolve this issue.

Israel's Channel 12 reported, citing two informed sources, that Donald Trump is still considering the possibility of a joint attack with Israel against the Islamic Republic. According to the report, the White House has requested an assessment of Tehran's possible reaction and its consequences for the security of oil and gas facilities in the Gulf countries.

On the evening of Wednesday, 27 Aban, Shamim Ettehadi, a Bahá'í citizen residing in Yazd, was arrested by intelligence officers and transferred to an unknown location. At the same time, the home of Iraj Ettehadi and Azam Motahari, Shamim Ettehadi's parents, was searched and personal belongings and electronic devices were confiscated. This report was published by Harana News Agency.

Aram News reported, citing informed Iraqi sources, that disputes within the IRGC over oil smuggling revenues have increased. At the same time, networks affiliated with Khatam al-Anbiya Headquarters and the Quds Force have expanded oil smuggling operations through Iraq.

Iran's national beach soccer team defeated Afghanistan 9-2 in their first match at the 2026 Asian Cup. Reza Diri scored three goals and Sobhan Faleh scored two, playing key roles in the victory. Iran is in Group B with Afghanistan, Vietnam, and Lebanon, and will face Vietnam and Lebanon in upcoming matches.
A video shows that female students at a school in Qazvin sang the anthem "Nam-e Javid-e Vatan" on 27 Aban.

A BBC report shows that the income gap between the six biggest Premier League clubs and other teams has sharply increased, and new financial regulations could further strengthen their power in the transfer market. Manchester United, Manchester City, Liverpool, Arsenal, Chelsea, and Tottenham now earn hundreds of millions of pounds more than other Premier League clubs. The average income gap between these six clubs and Everton has risen from 120 million pounds in the 2009–2010 season to 442 million pounds in the 2024–2025 season.
The deputy prosecutor of the central province of Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari reported the arrest of a sports coach accused of rape in Shahr-e Kord.

Donald Trump, President of the United States, called for talks to reduce the number of nuclear weapons and lower the risk of their use during a trilateral meeting with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin. Trump said the US, Russia, and China have a special position to advance such talks. He added that giving up nuclear weapons is difficult for leaders of countries that possess them, and other countries also have nuclear weapons, though in smaller numbers.

Morteza Kazemian, a member of the Iran International editorial team, said Trump has sidelined the possibility of short-term military action by setting a timeframe until the start of the new calendar year. He also considered Trump's meeting with the leaders of Russia and China, given the role of these two countries in supporting the Islamic Republic, influential in determining the future path of US policy towards Tehran and compared it to the Guadeloupe Conference in January 1979.
A received video shows that a protesting citizen wrote the slogan "Long live the Shah" on a street wall at night.

Mohammad Javad Akbarin, a member of Iran International's editorial team, said reports about the activities of the Lebanese charity association "Wataawon" and its money transfer routes indicate the possibility of Hezbollah using charitable activities as a cover to finance military and armament activities. He emphasized that using aid and public service routes for military purposes ultimately harms the people of southern Lebanon.

Iran International audiences report a renewed increase in food prices including bread, eggs, and dairy products over one week. Rationing of subsidized bread and an increase in the price of free-market bread have also been mentioned. More details are provided by Leila Saadati, a member of Iran International's editorial team.

Iranian media reported that Mostafa Motadin, CEO of Esteghlal, opposed Sohrab Bakhtiari-Zadeh's resignation and is trying to resolve the issues he protested to enable the coach's return to training. Bakhtiari-Zadeh resigned due to lack of facilities and poor training conditions. Motadin emphasized the support of all club management bodies for Bakhtiari-Zadeh.

Donald Trump, President of the United States, said in a bilateral meeting with Xi Jinping, President of China, that Washington and Beijing want to guarantee the continued flow of energy through the Strait of Hormuz. He added that the US and China also agree on preventing Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons and have a "very firm stance" on both issues.

Donald Trump, the President of the United States, during a meeting with the Presidents of Russia and China in Shenzhen, reiterated that he will not allow the Islamic Republic to obtain nuclear weapons. He also said that nuclear arms reduction is a negotiable issue.
A citizen sent a video to Iran International reporting that they witnessed a drone flying at night over the city of Mahallat in Markazi province.

Iranian media reported that Judge Ebrahim Sadeghi, his wife, and young son were killed in an armed attack by an individual in Tabriz. The family's daughter survived the attack, and the assailant also survived after attempting suicide.

According to the regulations of the Republic of Azerbaijan, clerics and professional religious activists are not allowed to work in government agencies. Also, using administrative positions to promote religion and formalize religious ceremonies in government institutions is prohibited.

The Hengaw Human Rights Organization reported that the number of detainees in the November 17 protests in Abdanan has increased to at least eight. Protesters took to the streets after a deadly bus overturn involving employees of the Dehloran Petro-Refinery and chanted slogans against the Islamic Republic. Hengaw stated that two detainees were released a few hours after arrest, but the fate of six others remains unknown.

Alireza Beiranvand, goalkeeper of Iran's national football team and Tractor, said before the Asian Footballer of the Year award ceremony in Bangkok that he could not sleep last night due to excitement. He has been nominated for this award for the second time since 2019 and competes with Salem Al-Dawsari and Firas Al-Buraikan. Beiranvand hopes this week will be a good week for Iranian football and Tractor team.

Rouhollah Rahimpour said Trump is trying to limit the political, economic, and military support of China and Russia for the Islamic Republic by approaching these two countries. He added that if the US goal is to distance Moscow and Beijing from Tehran, the likelihood of cooperation from these two powers is higher. A regime change in Iran could lead to the loss of strategic influence for China and Russia.

Leaders of China, the United States, and Russia stated in a joint declaration after the Shenzhen trilateral meeting that no one would win a nuclear war and such a war must never happen. They committed to dialogue to reduce nuclear risks and prevent the spread of these weapons. They also intend to increase the production and supply of petroleum products and agree that the International Criminal Court and similar bodies should not abuse their jurisdiction.

The broadcast of the program "Sahneh," which was scheduled to start on 9 Azar, was stopped by judicial order following a complaint by the Regulatory Authority for Audio-Visual Media (SATRA). The Filimo platform, as the distributor, announced that SATRA's complaint was related to the program's promotional teaser, which included a song by Ebi and group singing by participants.

The Deputy Director General and Head of the Environmental Protection Department of Tehran County reported that 50% of passenger cars and 55% of motorcycles active in the province are worn out. He also stated that about 77% of buses, nearly 50% of taxis, around 30% of pickups, and 10% of trucks and light trucks in Tehran are worn out. These worn-out vehicles significantly contribute to worsening air pollution.
The detention order for Amir Salar Davoodi, a detained lawyer, was extended for another month. He has also been deprived of the ability to contact his family during his detention.
A video received by Iran International shows that in Ardabil, anti-government slogans against Mojtaba Khamenei and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps are written on a wall.

Three days after the protest gathering of the people of Abdanan, Iran International's audience continues to support the protesters by sending messages. Citizens praised the steadfastness of the people of this city and emphasized the need for solidarity among other cities, while expressing concern about the security of the protesters.

Today, Thursday 28 Aban, workers of Kaveh Sodium Carbonate Company in Firuzabad held a protest in front of the entrance gate of the complex. They demanded attention to the livelihood conditions of the workers and addressing their demands.
The deputy public and revolutionary prosecutor of Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari reported the closure of a cafe in Shahr-e Kord due to holding mixed-gender parties.

Maryam Darisi, a resident of Kazeroon, was summoned to serve her prison sentence. According to a notification issued on 26 Aban 1405 by the Criminal Enforcement Branch of the Public and Revolutionary Prosecutor's Office of Kazeroon, Ms. Darisi was asked to appear at the mentioned judicial branch within 10 days to serve her sentence.

Hossein Mohibi, spokesperson for the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, announced on Thursday, 28 Aban, that Israel will not tolerate the countries of the region and will go after them. He also stated that the enemy, after failing to eliminate the existence of the Islamic Republic, is seeking an identity war. Mohibi added that with the resistance of the people and the armed forces, we have passed the stage of existential war and entered the stage of identity war, in which the enemy wants to destroy our identity and religion.

Sohrab Bakhtiarizadeh, the resigned head coach of Esteghlal, said in an interview that Tajernia has failed to provide the basic facilities for Esteghlal football team while seeking to manage teams in other sports. Bakhtiarizadeh also accused Tajernia of using Esteghlal to sustain his political life.

The European Union called on Tehran to quickly facilitate the resumption of nuclear inspections at the IAEA Board of Governors meeting. EU member states warned that time is limited and the Islamic Republic should not acquire nuclear weapons.

A resident of Ahvaz sent a video to Iran International showing his purchase receipt, which recorded the price of two packs of lavash bread as 500,000 tomans and the cost of a plastic bag as 5,000 tomans. He said the price of each loaf of bread is 25,000 tomans.

The appellate court confirmed the prison sentence and permanent removal of clerical attire for Ahmad Heydari. He had previously been sentenced to three years, three months, and one day in prison, permanent removal of clerical attire, two years of prohibition from promotional activities, and permanent blocking of his personal channel. The appellate court suspended two-thirds of the prison sentence for five years.
Hassan Faraji, a citizen from Ilam, has been detained by security forces in this city for eight days, and there is still no information about his place of detention or his condition.

Marzieh Jafari, head coach of Khatoun Bam football team, won the Best Female Football Coach in Asia award for the second consecutive year. She won this award at the 2026 Asian Football Awards, surpassing Park Yoon Jung and Ma Xiaozhu. Jafari had also won this title last year.

A citizen accused Masoud Pezeshkian in a video sent to Iran International of deceiving people with electoral promises and said that the country's resources were spent on Lebanon, Palestine, Gaza, and proxy forces instead of Iran's infrastructure. He added that these problems were not created by the enemy but by Pezeshkian, calling him the enemy of the people.

Reports indicate the possibility of a large-scale renewed attack by the US against Iran. Benjamin Netanyahu, Israel's Prime Minister, has pressured Washington to participate in a four to seven-day airstrike campaign against the Islamic Republic. The Pentagon has deployed extensive military equipment in the region, with bombers on 96-hour alert.

Donald Trump, the President of the United States, said in a trilateral meeting with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen, China, that the three leaders are "making history." The Ukraine war and major global issues were discussed, but the joint statement emphasized general principles of cooperation and did not directly mention the wars in Iran and Ukraine. Trump stressed the need to prevent Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons, but there was no specific agreement on Iran in the statement.

Alireza Beiranvand, goalkeeper of Iran's national football team and Tractor, ended Iran's 22-year wait for the title by winning the 2026 Asian Player of the Year award. He won the award at the Asian Football Awards ceremony in Bangkok, ahead of Saudi nominees Salem Al-Dawsari and Firas Al-Buraikan. Beiranvand is the fifth Iranian player to receive this award.

A reception hall in Boukan was sealed. It was reported that a reception hall in Boukan was sealed for reasons including what was called "failure to observe social norms and customs," and the manager of this business unit was referred to the judicial authority.

Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping held a trilateral meeting in Shenzhen, China, discussing major international issues including the Ukraine war, Iran's nuclear program, and nuclear disarmament. The leaders emphasized the necessity of cooperation, mutual respect, and maintaining global peace and security.

Theo Francken, Belgium's defense minister, announced that his government will try to include Yemen's Houthis in the European Union's list of terrorist organizations. This stance comes while only a limited number of EU member states support this action.

Mostafa Tajzadeh, a political prisoner held in Evin Prison, was returned to Evin Prison after three nights of hospitalization. His wife stated that Tajzadeh was hospitalized for medical tests and examinations but was returned to prison before the tests were completed. It was also reported that some officers treated them inappropriately.

The International Court of Justice in The Hague ruled on Thursday, 28 Aban, with 9 judges in favor and 6 against, that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya Muslim minority during the 2017 military operations. The court also ordered Myanmar to ensure the safe return of Rohingya refugees and to prosecute those responsible for the genocide. This ruling was issued following a complaint by Gambia in 2019 and based on the 1948 Genocide Convention.

Tina (Tooba) Moradi Moghui, a detainee related to the nationwide protests of Dey 1404, was released from Varamin Qarchak Prison on Tuesday, 26 Aban 1405 under electronic monitoring. Her release was made with a bail of two billion tomans. She will serve the remainder of her sentence outside prison with travel restrictions.

Mehdi Tartaar, Persepolis coach, denied rumors of discord in his team's locker room in a press conference before the match against Paykan and reported the readiness of national players after international matches. He emphasized that Persepolis must win this match and also commented on the injured players and the possibility of hiring a foreign assistant.

The second branch of the Yazd Revolutionary Court issued sentences for four detainees of the January 1404 protests and defendants in the Yazd Telecommunications case. Pouya Fakhrabadi was sentenced to death, and Mehdi Rajabi, Mohammad Kargar, and Mohini Maki each received 20 years of exile imprisonment. These individuals are currently held in Yazd prison.
A video shows that on 27 Aban students at a girls' high school in Mashhad sang the anthem "Nam-e Javid Vatan" together.

Hossein Mohseni, spokesperson for the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, said in a speech at the University of Tehran that the senior spokesperson of the Armed Forces General Staff had previously announced that media such as Iran International are targets of the Islamic Republic's armed forces. Abolfazl Shekarchi, the senior spokesperson of the armed forces, had earlier threatened Iran International, BBC Persian, Radio Farda, and their staff with being placed on the list of military targets.

Vladimir Putin, President of Russia, said after a trilateral meeting with Donald Trump and Xi Jinping that he has no doubt Trump is "sincerely" trying to resolve disputes, including the war in Ukraine, and improve US-Russia relations. Putin added that Moscow wants this process to move faster and more effectively but acts based on "existing realities" and hopes Trump's approach continues.

Scott Busent, the US Treasury Secretary, predicted that Iran's economy will shrink by more than 25 percent within one year. These remarks come nearly three months after the start of the Trump administration's economic expulsion operation against the Islamic Republic. Mehdi Beigi reviewed the dimensions and achievements of this operation over the past three months in "Peyvast".

Amirhossein Bankipour, a member of the Cultural Commission of the Parliament, said that the implementation of the Youth Population Law has reduced the rate of voluntary pregnancy termination by 50 percent and has somewhat controlled the population decline trend in Iran.

Bloomberg reported, citing Western officials, that the likelihood of a new round of extensive US attacks against Iran has increased. Donald Trump has not made a final decision but is considering another attack. Benjamin Netanyahu has requested a joint air operation against Iran, while European governments and Gulf Arab states urge restraint from extensive attacks.

France, Germany, Britain, and the United States expressed concern about ambiguities in the nuclear activities of the Islamic Republic and demanded immediate access for the International Atomic Energy Agency to the Isfahan facilities. These four countries also stated that the agency's information on Iran's enriched uranium stockpiles has not been updated since Esfand 1404.

Masoud Pezeshkian, head of the Islamic Republic government, made recommendations to the public to reduce energy consumption and made remarks about sleeping with a jacket, which sparked reactions from citizens. Several viewers sent messages to Iran International's media platform criticizing him. One citizen said Pezeshkian sleeps with a jacket and clothes on so that if necessary, he can take shelter in a tunnel or bunker.

Hassan Roshan, an Iranian football veteran, said in an interview with Haft Varzeshi about Alireza Beiranvand being chosen as Asia's best player of the year: "We were always happy when an Iranian won the Asian Man of the Year award, but this time I am upset because Beiranvand showed his low side."

A citizen sent a video to Iran International showing smoke rising from the Behbahan refinery and spreading in the city's sky. He said this pollution is really carcinogenic for the people of Behbahan. The situation of this refinery has made the city's air very polluted and dangerous.
The commander of the police in Somesara reported the arrest of a citizen in this county due to what was described as "spreading false information and disturbing public opinion in cyberspace."

The United States, Russia, and China signed a joint statement titled "Peace Declaration" at the end of a trilateral meeting. The statement emphasizes reducing nuclear risks, reforming the United Nations structure, stabilizing energy markets, and respecting the immunity of official country representatives.

The family of Robert Levinson, a former FBI agent who disappeared in Iran, wants to seize nearly one and a half billion dollars from a Malaysian bank. The US Court of Appeals is addressing this request today. Levinson's family considers Kuwait Finance House linked to the Iranian government and has previously obtained a default judgment against the Islamic Republic.

The Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned the Houthi attacks on civilian and economic facilities in Riyadh on Thursday, 28 Aban, stating that these attacks damaged the King Abdullah Financial Center. The ministry called the attacks "terrorist" and said Saudi Arabia will not yield to attacks on its land and facilities. Additionally, the official Saudi news agency, SPA, reported that the Houthi attack on a tower in Riyadh's financial district caused damage to several floors and surrounding buildings, but no one was injured.

The Saudi Civil Defense Organization announced on Thursday, 28 Aban, that a tower in Riyadh's financial center was damaged during a Houthi attack from Yemen. The attack caused material damage to several floors of the tower and adjacent buildings, but no casualties or injuries have been reported. Rescue teams and relevant authorities have immediately arrived at the scene and started necessary measures to secure the area and assess the damage.
A video sent to Iran International shows that the slogan "Long live the Shah" was written overnight on a wall in Urmia.

Vladimir Putin said that until the political leaders of some European countries change, Russia-Europe relations will not be fully restored. Mark Carney said Canada wants a trade agreement with the US, but if Washington is unwilling, Canada will expand trade with other countries.

The number of detainees related to the protest gathering in Abdanan county has reached eight. Another citizen named Shahram Javidaneh has been added to this group. So far, there is no information about the location or condition of the detainees.

"GTA 6", the latest game by Rockstar, will be released on Thursday, 28 Aban. However, Iranian gamers face sanctions, slow and limited internet, and a 40% increase in internet tariffs. Iranian users have expressed regret about experiencing this game on social media.

Donald Trump said in an interview with NBC News about his trip to China and meetings with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin that everything went great and excellent relations were formed. He added that he and Xi Jinping believe that setting at least minimum regulatory frameworks for artificial intelligence is a positive step. When asked about the meaning of "minimum level," Trump said they did not enter into discussions about definitions.

The death of oil industry workers in a bus rollover accident sparked new protests in Abdanan. Despite memories of the killing of protesters in Dey 1404 and the risks of death, arrest, and torture, the people of Abdanan took to the streets again. Reports indicate security forces clashed with protesters, fired tear gas, shot in the air, and arrested several citizens, including a 15-year-old teenager.
On the evening of Thursday, 28 Aban, following security forces shooting at two citizens riding a motorcycle in Sarbaz County, one person was killed and another injured.

Shervin Savadkoohi said the Neka intelligence office repeatedly summoned and threatened Farzad Khosh-Bersh's father and sister in the week leading up to his memorial ceremony. Agents told Khosh-Bersh's father he might die in a car accident on his way back to work in Asaluyeh. The intelligence office also asked the family for a list of guests and speech texts and told some of Khosh-Bersh's friends they were not allowed to attend the ceremony, but the family held the event despite the threats.

Satellite images show the spread of oil slicks near the United Arab Emirates waters reaching the country's shores. Wim Zwijnenburg, an environmental expert at Pax, told Reuters that satellite images from November 18 show oil slicks from a ship fire have reached the UAE shores. Sarbananda Sonowal, India's shipping minister, had earlier stated that the ship was attacked on November 11 while near Mina Saqr port in the UAE.

Three months of overdue payments to retired armed forces personnel have not been paid. According to an activist from the armed forces fund, out of the four months of overdue payments, only one month will be paid along with the November salary.

Reza Najafi, Iran's representative to the International Atomic Energy Agency, warned that information collected from Iran's nuclear facilities by the agency "will certainly be used for further attacks." He supported the joint statement by China, Iran, and Russia and opposed removing Rafael Grossi's report from the list of confidential documents. Najafi described Grossi's remarks about the interruption of the agency's continuous awareness of Iran's nuclear activities as incomplete and uncertain, stating that Iran has cooperated extensively with the agency.

A death row prisoner in Ramian County, Golestan Province, was released from execution due to the victim's family's pardon. Also, the judicial deputy and dispute resolution official of Kerman Province reported the release of 15 death row prisoners in this province during the first seven months of the current year.
Due to lack of workplace safety and unsuitable conditions, an electrician worker in Tehran had an accident while working and died.

Donald Trump said in an interview with Barak Ravid that he has not yet decided on the next actions of the US in the war with Iran. Trump said he is not in a hurry to decide about Iran and they must see what happens after January 1. Ravid reported that Trump is under pressure from Netanyahu for a quick return to war and is still considering another attack on Iran.

Saberin news agency, affiliated with the IRGC, reported that the Islamic Republic is considering resuming oil exports despite the US naval blockade. The agency wrote that dozens of Iranian tankers are preparing to head towards China. It also announced that Tehran has warned regional countries that it will enter a war if the US attacks tankers bound for China.
Today, Thursday 28 Aban, a group of unemployed youth in Gachsaran held a protest for the second consecutive day by blocking the route to the county's petro-refinery.
The Domino audio version reports that the people of Abdanan have returned to the streets.

At least 3 protest gatherings were held today, Thursday 28 Aban, including workers of Kaveh Sodium Carbonate Company in Firouzabad protesting living conditions. Bakers in Ahvaz gathered in front of Khuzestan Governor's Office. Also, unemployed youth in Gachsaran blocked the road to the petro-refinery for the second consecutive day.

According to Samira Qaraei, Vladimir Putin's presence at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit after nine years has attracted much attention on social media. Users are analyzing his body language and behavior alongside Donald Trump and Xi Jinping. Many believe these images indicate that Putin was not the distinguished guest at the summit as the Kremlin tries to portray.
Abdelhay Dashti, a resident of Chabahar, was summoned and interrogated by the Intelligence of the Revolutionary Guards in this city on Tuesday, 26 Aban.
It was reported in the audio version 24 with Fardad Farahzad that Trump is seeking a widespread attack on the Islamic Republic.

Sanaz Yekta, a resident of Tehran, was summoned by the Tehran Security Prosecutor's Office and appeared there on Tuesday, 25 Aban. The charges against her include "propaganda against the regime" and interviews with foreign media. She was summoned by the Ministry of Intelligence's follow-up office in early Mehr, detained, and later released on bail.

FIFA announced the names of three candidates for the presidency election of the organization in 2027. Gianni Infantino, Philippe Diallo, and Kozo Tashima are the candidates. The election will be held on March 18 in Rabat, Morocco.

The International Football Federation released the latest national team rankings for 2026 after the November FIFA dates, with Spain maintaining first place despite a 3-2 loss to England. Morocco rose two places to fifth, their best ranking ever. Iran remained 23rd in the world and second in Asia, while Japan leads Asian football.

Reports from various cities in Iran have presented reactions to Masoud Pezeshkian's statements about people's problems. From Miandoab to Tehran, people have criticized the difficult living conditions and the government's inability to provide basic needs such as electricity and gas. Some have said Pezeshkian is unaware of the real situation of the people and that his salary is not equal to workers'.

Reuters reported that the US Senate rejected a resolution to limit Donald Trump's war powers against Iran by 51 votes against 48. The resolution, previously passed by the House of Representatives, would have required Trump to end the war with Iran or get congressional approval to continue it. The Senate vote was largely along party lines, with Republicans supporting Trump.
